title: Privacy-IDS: Code and derived results for measuring host re-identification risk in intrusion detection datasets
description: Analysis code and derived results accompanying the manuscript Measuring Host Re-identification Risk in Intrusion Detection Datasets: An Attack-Based Comparison of Privacy Techniques. Includes Python scripts for data inventory, preprocessing, re-identification attacks, privacy transformations, cross-scenario comparisons, robustness checks, and figure generation, with derived JSON results. The raw CICIDS2017 and UNSW-NB15 benchmark datasets are not redistributed and must be obtained from their original providers. The clipped Laplace perturbation scenario uses a nominal composed budget and does not provide a formal differential privacy guarantee for the joint release.
